candelabrum-with-two-blindfolded-women.description: A tall, narrow, symmetrical engraved candelabrum. At the top a winged putto stands on a leafy cushion with both arms raised, gripping the curled tips of two acanthus volutes. Below him a lobed cup, a gadrooned bowl and a baluster stem with a second small bowl, each stage flanked by mirrored acanthus scrolls and leaf sprays. At the base two nude blindfolded women kneel back to back with spiral volutes in place of arms and carry the shaft on their heads. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.

provenance.object_title: Panel of Ornament with Candelabra Supported by Two Blindfolded Women
provenance.rights_text: Open Access / public domain; official image dataset openaccess=1

candelabrum-with-two-blindfolded-women.quality: The bottom edge between the two women is cut straight where the date panel of the print was removed.
candelabrum-with-two-blindfolded-women.title: Candelabrum carried by two blindfolded women
usage_notes: Complete vertical ornament about six times taller than wide; it reads as a column or a page edge, not as a divider.
The date and monogram panel that sits below the two women in the print is not included.

centaurs-and-riders-foliate-frieze.description: A horizontal engraved frieze of four centaurs, two on each side, rearing toward the centre. The two inner centaurs, bearded and leaf-crowned, each carry a young rider and together grip a leafy spray that rises from a small bowl at the bottom centre; the two outer centaurs carry nude women who hold long feathery fronds arching over the ends. Trefoil sprigs and a low band of acanthus scrolls run between the hooves. Black ink line work on cream paper, no rules, background transparent.

provenance.rights_text: Open Access / public domain; official image dataset openaccess=1

centaurs-and-riders-foliate-frieze.title: Frieze of four centaurs with riders
usage_notes: Complete band about three times wider than tall; the fronds at both ends are its natural terminals, so no cropping is needed.

double-cup-with-two-putti.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1919.19
double-cup-with-two-putti.description: A tall, symmetrical engraved double cup. A round foot and knopped stem carry a bulbous lower bowl, a wide band decorated with masks, lozenges and strapwork, and an inverted upper bowl topped by a small cup; thin leafy tendrils with two small birds rise from the sides and tasselled pendants hang at the left and right. At the base two winged putti sit on either side of the stem, each resting a hand on a blank strapwork cartouche. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.

provenance.institution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg
provenance.object_title: Doppelpokal, unten zwei Putti mit Wappenschilden

double-cup-with-two-putti.title: Double cup with two putti
usage_notes: The two cartouches at the base are blank and small; the piece is a goldsmith's design, not a frame for text.

horned-helmet-with-leafy-mantling-and-sh.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1915.1
horned-helmet-with-leafy-mantling-and-sh.description: An engraved coat of arms. A tilted shield bears a diagonal band charged with three small shields. Above it a closed tilting helmet turned to the right carries a crest of two tall curved horns with trumpet-shaped ends. Leafy mantling hangs from knotted ties on each side of the helmet and curls down around the shield in scalloped acanthus fronds. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.

provenance.institution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg

horned-helmet-with-leafy-mantling-and-sh.title: Coat of arms with horned helmet
usage_notes: The shield is tilted and the helmet faces right; mirror the whole piece for a left-facing use.

large-bearded-mask-with-paired-leafy-hea.description: A horizontal, symmetrical engraved panel centred on a large frontal mask of a bearded man with an open mouth, small curled horns at the temples and a ribbed cap bound with a leaf garland; his beard flows down into leaf fronds. From the cap two long swags of overlapping leaves fall to either side, and thin stems with acanthus volutes, lobed leaves and small buds fill both halves. Halfway down each side a leafy beaked head bites a stem. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.

provenance.object_title: Ornament Panel with a Large Bearded Mask
provenance.rights_text: Open Access / public domain; official image dataset openaccess=1

large-bearded-mask-with-paired-leafy-hea.title: Bearded mask in a leaf scroll
usage_notes: Complete symmetrical panel; the mask reads from a distance, so it works as a headpiece above a title.

lion-shield-with-helmet-and-feathered-cr.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1906.118
lion-shield-with-helmet-and-feathered-cr.description: An engraved coat of arms. A tilted shield bears a rampant lion with a curled tail, facing left. Above it a closed tilting helmet turned to the right carries a tall crest of two fans of feathers rising from a twisted wreath. Plain cloth mantling with scalloped edges hangs in long folds on both sides of the helmet and tucks behind the shield. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.

provenance.institution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg

lion-shield-with-helmet-and-feathered-cr.title: Coat of arms with rampant lion and feather crest
usage_notes: The lion faces left and the helmet right, so the piece has no single direction; mirroring it changes the lion's heraldic side.

palmette-with-dolphin-heads-and-leaf-scr.description: A horizontal, symmetrical engraved panel. A large palmette fan rises from a small pedestal with two volutes at the bottom centre; below it two scaly dolphin heads with open toothed jaws face each other. To each side thin stems curl into acanthus volutes with lobed leaves, a trumpet-shaped horn, a round berry, a bud and a small flower head, ending in upright leaf clusters at the outer edges. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.

palmette-with-dolphin-heads-and-leaf-scr.title: Palmette between two dolphin heads

rooster-shield-and-helmet-with-leafy-man.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg JB1891.590
rooster-shield-and-helmet-with-leafy-man.description: An engraved coat of arms. A rounded shield bears a strutting rooster facing left on a stippled ground. Above it a closed tilting helmet turned to the left carries a coronet on which a crowned rooster stands between two curved horns, also facing left. Leafy acanthus mantling curls down both sides of the shield, and long blank banderoles loop above and beside the helmet. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.

provenance.institution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg

rooster-shield-and-helmet-with-leafy-man.title: Coat of arms with rooster and banderoles
usage_notes: The banderoles are blank and narrow; they are decoration, not a text field.

summary: A centaur frieze, candelabrum and mask panels, a palmette with dolphin heads, a double cup and three heraldic shields engraved by Sebald Beham, 1521–1545, from eight sheets in Washington and Hamburg; loose prints by one artist, grouped by sheet.
title: Sebald Beham ornament prints
